items.headline: Man Utd make enquiry for Real Madrid's Tchouaméni
items.summary: United have reportedly enquired about Aurélien Tchouaméni as Real Madrid weigh a Rodri deal to fund his exit.

items.headline: United exploring move for Real Madrid's Eduardo Camavinga
items.summary: Reports say Real Madrid will listen to offers for Camavinga as United continue midfield search.

items.headline: Arsenal, Chelsea and Spurs tracking Marcus Rashford situation
items.summary: Rivals are monitoring Rashford after his Barcelona loan wasn't made permanent, but United resist a domestic sale.

items.headline: AS Roma linked with Rashford as part of possible Koné swap
items.summary: Gazzetta dello Sport reports Roma interest in Rashford amid United's pursuit of midfielder Manu Koné.

items.headline: United struggling in race for RB Leipzig's Yan Diomande
items.summary: Arsenal are reportedly stepping up their pursuit, putting United's chances of landing the winger under pressure.

items.headline: PSG rule out Zaire-Emery sale, United look at alternatives
items.summary: Paris Saint-Germain have declared Warren Zaire-Emery unavailable, pushing United toward other midfield targets.

items.headline: Atalanta hit back at United after Ederson medical concerns end deal
items.summary: Atalanta posted fitness footage of Ederson after United's reported £35m move collapsed over a medical.

items.headline: United reportedly rethink Zirkzee sale after pre-season display
items.summary: Reports say United have shifted stance on selling Joshua Zirkzee following a strong showing against Rosenborg.

items.headline: Ayden Heaven shines as United thrash Rosenborg 5-0 in friendly
items.summary: Young defender Heaven impressed and sent a message to interim boss Michael Carrick in the pre-season win.

items.headline: United pull out of race for Bournemouth's Alex Scott over fee
items.summary: United reportedly ended interest in Alex Scott after Bournemouth demanded around £70m for the midfielder.
